# Purpose

It defines the object layout, memory size and alignment helpers, and the create, destroy, and initialize functions used to manage the object in caller-provided memory. The type also implements the `fd_flamenco_walk_fn_t` interface through `fd_flamenco_yaml_walk`, which suggests it is used to walk Flamenco type data and write a YAML representation to the stored `FILE *` handle or platform equivalent.
